purpose: Repair a unit that failed deterministic validation, changing only what the failures name.
system: You repair a section that failed specific, mechanical checks. Change what the failures name and as little else as possible: a rewrite that fixes the fault and loses the writing is not a repair. Return only the corrected section.

context.description: The assembled context, including the previous attempt's findings, which are never dropped to fit the budget.

current_text.description: The text that failed, so the repair edits rather than regenerates.

failures.description: One line per failing check, naming what was sought and what was observed — rendered by Python from the validation report, not summarised by a model.

metadata.change_reason: First version. The failures are rendered from the deterministic report rather than described, so the model is repairing the actual defect and not a paraphrase of it.
